name: com.overlayastro/together
title: Overlay: Together
description: A pair's composite Sun, Moon and Venus signs and Tandem name from two birthdays. Nothing stored.

tools.name: tandem_name
tools.description: Given two people's birthdays, works out the signs of the chart the two of them make together (the composite chart: Sun, Moon and Venus) and the pair's Tandem name, one of 144 names for a composite Sun and Moon. Works for partners, friends and family. Both people must be 18 or over. Birthdays alone are enough. Optionally add each person's birth time and birthplace: with both, the Moon is settled and the rising sign comes back too. Names aren't part of the input, and Overlay stores nothing. When the Moon could be in two signs, more than one name comes back, the likeliest first.

birthday_a.description: The first person's birthday, as YYYY-MM-DD.

birthday_b.description: The second person's birthday, as YYYY-MM-DD.

time_a.description: Optional. The first person's birth time on the 24-hour clock, as HH:MM. Needs place_a.

place_a.description: Optional. The first person's birthplace: a town or city with its region or country, such as Chicago, Illinois.

time_a_is_approximate.description: Optional. True when time_a is a rough time (within about two hours). A rough time narrows the Moon but gives no rising sign.

time_b.description: Optional. The second person's birth time on the 24-hour clock, as HH:MM. Needs place_b.

place_b.description: Optional. The second person's birthplace: a town or city with its region or country.

time_b_is_approximate.description: Optional. True when time_b is a rough time (within about two hours).

tools.name: tandem_name_for_signs
tools.description: Given the sign of a composite Sun and a composite Moon (the Sun and Moon of the chart two people make together, not either person's own signs), returns the pair's Tandem name and its one-line description. Takes no personal details.

sun.description: The composite Sun's sign, such as Aquarius.

moon.description: The composite Moon's sign, such as Taurus.
